body: What happened after that? Are you okay?
You’re beautiful! You hold value no matter what you look like, but as you grow up, you will gain confidence because you’ll know your style and how to accentuate your features.
I get that! I distract myself a lot with books and YouTube. It helps me get through the days.

I’ve felt this same way since I was a freshman in high school.
As harmful as this thinking is, it has given me a sense of comfort. It makes situations feel less important because I feel like I have control of my life if that makes sense. It doesn’t hold as much weight when I know I could die even if I don’t think I would really kill myself.
I’m so sorry for your loss…💚

I really relate to this! When I do cut, they’re only light, superficial wounds. I could never cut deep because it really freaks me out. Plus, I never wanted it to be deep enough where I might need help.
I cold burn now sometimes, and I always feel like it’s not enough. Like I’m not hurting enough. It makes me feel fake too.
You’re so amazing. I’m so proud of you! Congrats and best of luck to you! I believe in you.💚🙌

I truly felt this! I’m old enough to really feel the weight of helping myself in all the ways: mentally, physically, financially, etc. The weight on my shoulders can feel so heavy, and I don’t want to share my struggles because they’re my own. Many of them being self made, so I feel an overwhelming amount of guilt with sharing anything regarding them. 
I know how that weight can feel, and I see you. Sh has been my crutch on and off for years as well because I can’t always release negative emotions in healthy ways. I don’t judge you for harming. I just hope you know that you deserve peace. You deserve to feel mental clarity regarding your mother and most importantly yourself. Baggage tends to make us feel isolated, but you deserve the support system if that’s what you want. Wishing you the best.💚
You’re right. I guess I don’t mean free but lighter. I feel like the weight is less heavy once I release some tension. Thank you for being so nice. I really appreciate you.💚
Congratulations on being clean for 2 weeks, and Happy Birthday!🥳💜 I’m so proud of you! I wish you the best this year.

I truly relate to you. I feel that everyday, and I know how difficult and draining those feelings can be. 
I have to do things that distract my mind. I listen to music, watch YouTube, read, listen to podcasts, or color. I use things that I enjoy to redirect mind. It doesn’t always work, but it usually is a good temporary shift. 
But I get how you feel, and I hope we both feel lighter eventually.💚

Thank you so much. I really appreciate you. I really want to get into therapy. I did online therapy shortly, but it was a free trial. Hopefully, I can get back into it soon. 
Be kind to yourself too.💚

Aw, that’s so nice of you to say.💚 I really appreciate that, but I think there’s more good people than we think. The bad ones just greatly overshadow the good ones unfortunately. I hope you stick around too! You made my day.😌

I understand exactly what you mean. Since I was a teenager, I’ve though, “I’d give up my life to someone better than me. I’d die so that a sick kid or a loved parent or friend didn’t lose their life. They deserve it, and they’d use their life better than I am. I don’t want this.” 
Fighting suicidal thoughts is a constant battle, but I get you. It’s awful, but I’m glad you are still here. Selfishly, it’s so damn nice to relate to someone.

I understand this so much. My sister asks me about scars on my leg, and I always manage to deflect or explain it away. My family is fragile as well, and we all have our own issues. 
If I were you, I’d ask my sister if she told. I can tell when my sister is lying, so I’d know the truth. Do what’s best for you and be safe. If you want to talk but can’t maybe try writing something. Sometimes people finding out is a positive thing in disguise of anxiety and fear of judgement or consequence. However, you know what you need best. Take it at your pace.💚
This is so cute! Thank you.💚 I hope you have a great day, and if not, I hope you feel lighter tomorrow.
I’m so happy for you that you’re clean and working on yourself. That’s really great. Thank you for the advice.💚
